structural_change: NEW kit (RTL-BUILD-KV M1, KV-INTEG/KITS-A): generated static tile qkd_kvs_attn of the KV die (5 children: qkd_attn_cal_gen, qkd_attn_fault_root, qkd_attn_result_face_s, qkd_attn_service_root, qkd_native_attention_programme; hard: none), from rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_die_20261017/qkd_kvs_tiles_hroot_ff_k.sv (sha256 77831bc28446) by tools/qwen_kv_die/kvs_tile_kits.py; one clock port ck (OT_KV_TILE_KITS).  Faces {'S': 1546, 'N': 1080, 'E': 626} pins on 302.4 x 302.4 um (die frame record (302.4, 302.4) ASSUMED -> this outline for KV-PLAN3).; HKV-RSTCAP fl1 10-19: closed g3 native capture 383.3 ps > 190 on 58 pins: rst_n 383.3 (async clear of every child), fin[0] 372.4 (pvfin stream valid fan-out), i_ctl[2]/[0] 338.0/334.2 (issue / capability enables of the 400-b command capture), fin data bits 190-224 (pin -> far first flop). Shared face landing standard (tools/ref_tile/face_land.py, spec face_land): top qkd_kvs_attn_fl = generated wrapper, rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (async assert, release +3 edges, zero steady-state cycles) + landed buses fin +1 edge, i_ctl +1 edge (rtl/lib/ot_pin_land.sv, one capture flop per bit at the face, anchored by io_flop_at_pins); core RTL unchanged. Die: rebind qkd_kvs_attn -> qkd_kvs_attn_fl, startup waits +3 edges, schedule prices fin +1, i_ctl +1 (lanes/HKV-RSTCAP.md).

reroute_reason.fix: input side: rst_n lands in ot_rst_relay (2 sync + 1 kept relay flop) so the pin has 3 flop sinks instead of the tile-wide async clear, and fin, i_ctl land in one face capture flop per bit (ot_pin_land, io_flop_at_pins anchors them at the pin); same outline / pin faces, core RTL unchanged
